caption:
Hours below zero, this year so far. ERCOT, the West hub: share of the 15-minute intervals from 1 January to 25 August with a real-time price below zero at the West hub was 15.95 percent of intervals in 2026, the highest of the 12 complete years held; the previous high was 13.49 percent of intervals in 2022. Below zero is no longer a rare quarter hour.

Checked before it was drafted: 11 complete years before 2026; the record period is complete; no gap in the window; it stands 18.3 percent above the previous high (2022).

The claim states a change; it does not say what caused it. The window is 1 January to 25 August of each year, the last local date the table holds for 2026.

Source: ercot_all_hub_prices_history, as the ERW holds it. ERW table: ercot_all_hub_prices_history.
